newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Tupras buys 100kt gas oil, sells 18kt naphtha.
newsitem.headline: Turk Tupras buys 100kt gas oil, sells 18kt naphtha.

text.p: Turkey's state oil refiner Tupras said in a statement it awarded four tenders to buy a total 100,000 tonnes of gas oil and another to sell 18,000 tonnes of naphtha.
Tupras said it will import 25,000 tonnes of gas oil for a premium of $12.95 per tonne from Cargill to be delivered at Iskenderun between April 14-18.

From Tempo it will buy 25,000 tonnes of gas oil at a premium of $10.70 to be delivered at Izmit on April 18-22 and another 25,000 tonnes at a premium of $9.74 per tonne deliverable between May 1-4, also at Izmit.
It said it will import a further 25,000 tonnes of gas oil from AGIP at a premium of $9.75 per tonne to be delivered at Izmit on April 25-27.
Tupras will sell Marc Rich 18,000 tonnes of naphtha from Izmit at a premium of $7.29 per tonne between April 15-17, it said.
